claim: Every run presents six irreversible choices and reaches an ending.
sandbox: fresh demo route; make six fixed choices; assert each prior choice disappears and an end screen appears

claim: The expedition has four reachable endings.
sandbox: fresh demo route for each scripted path; reach and assert all four named endings through the rendered game

claim: Restart clears every choice and returns all resources to 7.
sandbox: make a choice, restart, and assert Camp 1 plus three resource meters at 7

claim: Demo play stays visibly labeled, is not saved, and does not change real browser data.
sandbox: seed a real-data sentinel; play, change settings, reset, finish a run, and assert the label remains in view and localStorage stays unchanged

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: own fresh browser context; load demo and wait for its service worker; set context offline; reload and continue play

claim: A full demo needs no account, sends no requests outside this site, and stores no demo data.
sandbox: fresh demo route; finish a run; assert no sign-in fields, no non-GET or cross-origin requests, no cookies, and empty localStorage

claim: Real play needs no account and sends no gameplay or settings to another service.
sandbox: fresh real-play route; change a setting and finish a run; assert no sign-in fields, cookies, non-GET requests, or cross-origin requests

claim: An unfinished real run is stored only after opt-in, resumes after reload, and Erase saved run removes it.
where: Local data and limits, Settings, Privacy, README
sandbox: fresh real-play route; prove a default choice is not stored, opt in and reload at Camp 2, erase the saved run, then reload at Camp 1
change real-play sound and save settings, reload, and assert the changed setting is restored

claim: The complete edition costs $6 once and sales are not open yet.
where: first screen, Complete edition, Terms, Purchase status, README
sandbox: compare the public offer response with rendered price and purchase-status route; assert no checkout is offered

claim: The same weather seed and route choices produce the same ending and resource summary.
sandbox: fresh demo route; play the same six choices twice after reset; compare the rendered ending and resource summary

claim: Route choices work with pointer, touch, Tab plus Enter or Space, and number keys 1–3.
sandbox: fresh demo routes; advance from Camp 1 with each advertised input method, including an isolated touch-enabled phone context

claim: Sound starts muted, and the reduce-motion setting stops the moving map marker.
sandbox: fresh real route with a counted AudioContext stub; verify muted default, enable reduce motion, and assert the map marker stays fixed while play continues

claim: A run stops after six choices, has no combat controls, and labels the story as fiction rather than survival advice.
where: Local data and limits, Terms, README
sandbox: fresh demo route; inspect each playable choice, finish six camps, assert choice controls stop at the ending, and verify the terms label

claim: The $6 complete edition contains eight additional weather seeds, eight matching relic variants, and a six-camp printable route log.
where: Complete edition, README, public offer metadata
sandbox: inspect the packaged game data and private paid deliverable; count paid seeds, unique relics, printable camp rows, and print styling

claim: The map animation targets 60 FPS and measures between 45 and 75 FPS in the Pixel 5 browser profile.
sandbox: fresh isolated Pixel 5 browser context; sample 90 requestAnimationFrame timestamps and assert the measured 45–75 FPS range
